body:
> That said, even without this PR, my PC can still go to sleep on Windows 11 24H2 when the editor is left inactive with no sound playing. I'd like this to get more testing to make sure it actually resolves an issue people were encountering on Windows.

Some audio drivers keep a stream-in-use power request when silent. You probably have a driver that doesn't. Either way, this should be explicit in the audio implementation instead of leaving it to driver magic.

In particular, the NVIDIA audio driver, which comes with the GPU drivers, keeps a request open even when silent. Without this PR, there is always a power request active when Godot is open, preventing the computer from sleeping.
```cmd
powercfg /requests

SYSTEM:
[DRIVER] NVIDIA High Definition Audio (....)
```
